ManyFaces validation/norming ratings

Compiling ratings by face

Code 
library(tidyverse)

# Load custom functions
source("data/custom_functions.R")

Load data

Code 
# Rating data
data_exp <- read_csv("data/manyfaces_ratings_exp_cleaned.csv",
                     show_col_types = FALSE)

exp_levels_neutral <- c("attractive", "trustworthy", "dominant", 
                        "memorable", "gender-typical")

exp_levels_neutral_unstd <- c("attractive (unstd)", 
                              "trustworthy (unstd)",
                              "dominant (unstd)")

exp_levels_emo_cat <- c("emotion 1", "emotion 2", "emotion 3", 
                        "emotion 4", "emotion 5", "emotion 6")

exp_levels_emo_int <- c("anger", "disgust", "fear", 
                        "happiness", "sadness", "surprise")

# Questionnaire data
data_qu <- read_csv("data/manyfaces_ratings_quest_cleaned.csv",
                    show_col_types = FALSE)

# Model data (available via UK Data Service ReShare)
data_model <- read_csv("ReShare_data/manyfaces_model_data_cleaned.csv",
                       show_col_types = FALSE)

rainbow <- c("firebrick", "darkorange", "goldenrod",
             "darkgreen", "dodgerblue3", "darkorchid4")

Standardised neutral trait ratings

Code 
std_neutral <- data_exp |>
  filter(exp %in% exp_levels_neutral) |>
  mutate(dv = as.integer(dv),
         exp = factor(exp, exp_levels_neutral)) |> 
  separate_wider_delim(trial_name,
                       delim = "_",
                       names = c("lab_id", "model_id"),
                       too_many = "drop")

std_neutral_by_gender <- std_neutral |> 
  left_join((data_model |> dplyr::select(lab_id, model_id, gender_rec)), by = c("lab_id", "model_id"))

Descriptive statistics

Code 
std_neutral |>
  summarise(N = n(),
            mean_rating = mean(dv),
            .by = c("exp", "lab_id", "model_id")) |> 
  summarise(N_raters = first(N),
            M = mean(mean_rating),
            SD = sd(mean_rating),
            .by = "exp") |> 
mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !any_of("N"), ~ round(.x, 2)))

attractive 84 3.44 0.63
trustworthy 88 4.18 0.47
gender-typical 80 5.18 0.48

mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !any_of("N"), ~ round(.x, 2)))

Histograms

Code 
# calculate proportions for plot
std_prop <- std_neutral |> 
  group_by(exp) |> 
  count(exp, dv) |> 
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) |>
  ungroup() 

# plot
std_prop |>
  ggplot(aes(x = dv, y = prop, fill = exp)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", show.legend = FALSE, 
                 colour = "white", alpha = .8)  +
  facet_wrap(~exp, ncol = 3, axes = "all_x", drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:7) +
  labs(title = "Standardized neutral trait ratings",
       x = "Rating",
       y="Proportion") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = rainbow, drop = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "plain"),
        title = element_text(size = 12))

Save mean rating for each face for each trait

Code 
std_neutral_means <- std_neutral |> 
  summarise(mean_rating = mean(dv),
            rater_N = n(),
            .by = c("exp", "lab_id", "model_id")) |> 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(lab_id, model_id),
              names_from = exp,
              #values_from = c(mean_rating, rater_N))
              values_from = mean_rating)

Ratings per model

Note: The heatmaps visualise the frequency distribution of ratings for each model (y-axis) from each lab (shown in separate panels). Darker tiles indicate that more raters gave a particular rating (x-axis) to that model.

Emotion categorisations

Code 
emo_cat <- data_exp |>
  filter(exp %in% exp_levels_emo_cat) |>
  mutate(exp = factor(exp, exp_levels_emo_cat),
         dv = factor(dv, levels = c("anger", "disgust", "fear", 
                                    "happiness", "sadness", 
                                    "surprise", "other"))) |> 
  separate_wider_delim(trial_name,
                       delim = "_",
                       names = c("lab_id", "model_id", NA, 
                                 "model_expression", NA),
                       too_many = "drop") |> 
  mutate(model_expression = forcats::fct_recode(model_expression,
                                                anger = "ang",
                                                disgust = "dis",
                                                fear = "fea",
                                                happiness = "hap",
                                                sadness = "sad",
                                                surprise = "sur"))

emo_cat_by_gender <- emo_cat |> 
  left_join((data_model |> dplyr::select(lab_id, model_id, gender_rec)), by = c("lab_id", "model_id"))

Descriptive statistics

Code 
emo_cat |> 
  group_by(model_expression) |> 
  count(model_expression, dv) |> 
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) |>
  ungroup() |> 
  dplyr::select(-n) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = dv,
              values_from = prop) |> 
  relocate(other, .after = surprise) |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))

Age ratings

Code 
dv_levels <- seq(20, 85, 5)
dv_labels <- paste(dv_levels-4, "-", dv_levels )
dv_labels[14] <- "81+"

age <- data_exp |>
  filter(exp == "age") |>
  mutate(dv = factor(dv, dv_levels, dv_labels)) |> 
  separate_wider_delim(trial_name,
                       delim = "_",
                       names = c("lab_id", "model_id"),
                       too_many = "drop")

Actual vs perceived age

Relate actual age to perceived modal age for each face

Code 
age_perc <- age_modes |> 
  mutate(age_mid = age_mode) |> 
  separate(age_mid, into = c("age_start", "age_end"), sep = "-", convert = TRUE) |> 
  mutate(age_perc = (age_start + age_end) / 2) |> 
  select(-age_start, -age_end)

age_by_face <- data_model |> 
  dplyr::select(lab_id, model_id, age) |> 
  rename(age_actual = age) |> 
  left_join(age_perc, by = c("lab_id", "model_id"))
Code 
# Get stats
age_by_face_cortest <- cor.test(age_by_face$age_actual, 
                                age_by_face$age_perc)
age_by_face_df <- age_by_face_cortest$parameter
age_by_face_r <- age_by_face_cortest$estimate
age_by_face_p <- age_by_face_cortest$p.value
if (age_by_face_p < .001) {
  age_by_face_p = .001
}
label_text <- sprintf("r(%.0f) = %.2f, p < %.3f", 
                      age_by_face_df, age_by_face_r, age_by_face_p)
Code 
age_by_face |> 
  filter(!is.na(age_actual) & !is.na(age_perc)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = age_actual, y = age_perc)) +
  geom_point(colour = "orchid", alpha=.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm",  formula = y ~ x, 
              se = TRUE, colour = "orchid") +
  annotate("text", x = 60, y = 40, label = label_text, hjust = 0) +
  labs(title = "Actual model age vs. perceived age",
       x = "Actual age", 
       y = "Mode perceived age") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "plain"),
        title = element_text(size = 12))

data_model |>
  ggplot(aes(x = height_cm)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "#F7AE8F", alpha = .8) +
  labs(title = "Model self-reported height",
       x = "height (cm)", 
       y = "count") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "plain"),
        title = element_text(size = 12))

descriptive statistics split by gender

Code 
data_model |>
  mutate(gender = gender_rec) |>
  summarise(
    .by = gender,
    n = n(),
    height_min = min(height_cm, na.rm = TRUE),
    height_max = max(height_cm, na.rm = TRUE),
    height_M = mean(height_cm, na.rm = TRUE),
    height_SD = sd(height_cm, na.rm = TRUE))
gender n height_min height_max height_M height_SD
female 106 149 180 165.3519 6.916629
male 75 163 193 178.5400 7.603756
non-binary 7 165 201 175.0371 12.041996
NA 2 167 169 168.0000 1.414214
